A woman of the midwife's camp

text.en: One more was counted the dawn that the full moon fell, and the steppe learned his name from the sound of a bell.
text.tr: Dolunay batarken sayıma bir eklendi, bozkır adını çanın sesinden öğrendi.

text.en: One more was counted the dawn that the full moon fell,
and the steppe learned his name from the sound of a bell.
You never asked who counts us.
Before there was anyone to count, there was water, and two black geese.
text.tr: Sayılacak kimse yokken su vardı, bir de iki kara kaz.

text.en: One was the Sky. The other he had made, and named him Kishi.
text.tr: Biri Gök'tü. Ötekini kendi yapmış, adını Kişi koymuştu.

text.en: Kishi wanted to fly higher than the Sky, and he fell, and the Sky had mercy.
text.tr: Kişi Gök'ten daha yükseğe uçmak istedi, düştü, Gök ona acıdı.

text.en: The Sky sent him for earth. One handful he gave. One he hid in his mouth. He wanted a land of his own.
text.tr: Gök onu dipten toprak getirmeye yolladı. Bir avucunu verdi, bir avucunu ağzında sakladı. Kendine bir toprak istedi.

text.en: The world grew, and the earth in his mouth grew with it. "Spit," said the Sky. He has not been full since.
text.tr: Dünya büyüdükçe ağzındaki toprak da büyüdü. «Tükür», dedi Gök. O gün bugündür doymadı.

text.en: The Sky took his name and drove him from the light. He has another now.
text.tr: Gök adını aldı, onu ışıktan sürdü. Artık başka bir adı var.

text.en: We do not say it by the fire. I will say it once.
text.tr: Ateş başında o adı söylemeyiz. Bir kez söyleyeceğim.

text.en: Erlik.
Then the Sky made others, nine, under a tree, and they needed a name, and one was lying empty.
text.tr: Sonra Gök başkalarını yarattı: bir ağacın altında dokuz insan. Onlara bir ad gerekti, boşta bir ad vardı.

text.en: Kishi. You are kishi. I am kishi.
text.tr: Kişi. Sen de kişisin, ben de.

text.en: Sky above, earth below, and between them, the children of Kishi.
text.tr: Üstte gök, altta yer; ikisinin arasında kişi oğlu.

text.en: Nobody counted them. Nobody needed to.
He wanted them. They wore his name. The Sky said no. So he took one.
text.tr: Onları istedi. Onun adını taşıyorlardı. Gök vermedi. O da birini aldı.

text.en: In the morning, somebody counted.
Eight.
Below the grass his river runs with our tears. Its name is: I am not full.
text.tr: Irmağı otun altından akar, gözyaşımızla akar. Adı Doymadım.

text.en: The Sky left them to themselves.
White stone struck black stone, and a spark fell, and the eight of them set three stones around it.
text.tr: Ak taş kara taşa vurdu, bir kıvılcım düştü; sekizi çevresine üç taş dizdi.

text.en: He came as far as the stones, and there he stopped.
He did not go away. He sat down outside the light, and began to count us.
text.tr: Gitmedi. Işığın dışına oturdu, bizi saymaya başladı.

text.en: So we count too. At every birth, a woman calls the count from the door.
text.tr: Biz de sayarız. Her doğumda bir kadın kapıya çıkıp sayıyı söyler.

text.en: The river hears. It has not changed its name.
At dawn the Tanhu stepped out of his tent and bowed to the rising sun; in the west the full moon had not yet set.
text.tr: Şafakta Tanhu çadırından çıktı, doğan güne eğildi; batıda dolunay daha batmamıştı.

text.en: One more.
Before there were empires of grass, there was only the wind, and those who could outlast it.
text.tr: Otun imparatorlukları yokken yalnız rüzgâr vardı, bir de ona dayanabilenler.

text.en: When Mete was eighteen, the Qin raised a wall against the sky and drove the Huns out of the Ordos.
text.tr: Mete on sekizindeyken Ç'in göğe karşı bir sur yükseltti, Hunları Ordos'tan sürdü.

text.en: To the east, the Donghu grew strong. To the west, the Yuezhi flourished. And between them, Teoman the Tanhu counted his horses and his years.
text.tr: Doğuda Tunghu güçleniyor, batıda Yüeçi serpiliyordu. Arada Tanhu Teoman atlarını ve yıllarını sayıyordu.

text.en: He had an heir called Mete, quick with a bow and slow to kneel. And he had a young wife, with a younger son.
text.tr: Mete adında bir veliahdı vardı; yayda çevik, diz çökmekte ağırdı. Bir de genç bir hatunu, ondan küçük bir oğlu.

text.en: So the Tanhu made peace with the Yuezhi, and sealed it the old way: with a son.
text.tr: Tanhu, Yüeçilerle barış yaptı ve onu eski usulle mühürledi: bir oğulla.

text.en: Mete rode west with no army and no bow. At the gate they tied a bell to his ankle and counted him like a head of cattle.
text.tr: Mete batıya ordusuz ve yaysız gitti. Kapıda ayağına bir çan bağladılar, onu bir baş hayvan gibi saydılar.

text.en: History remembers the Tanhu he became. This is the hostage he was.
text.tr: Tarih, sonradan olduğu Tanhu'yu yazar. Bu, önce olduğu rehinenin hikâyesi.

text.en: Up. It's the count today, and you're letting the sheep out.
text.tr: Kalk, bugün sayım var. Koyunları ağıldan sen çıkaracaksın.

text.en: Forty head. Get every one of them out.
Hurry! You have to open the gate.
Walk behind them. They run from you.
There's still one inside.
Race you to the stone?
The old one's yours. The fast one's mine.
I'm first!
The old one made it anyway.
How did the old one run like that?
Get down and come! The larks are over here!
text.tr: İnin de gelin! Tarla kuşları burada!

text.en: Let's see who hits the first bird.
That one's mine. Don't forget it at the count.
She has young.
But she had young.
There! In the short grass.
One.
Two.
One mouse.
She's eating again!
The old one's hungry.
Prod her, go on!
She can eat later!
Did your sheep fall asleep?
At this rate you'll get there by nightfall!
Too high!
The bird's laughing at you.
Again!
Slowly. Breathe.
A little lower.
Get closer, then let go.
It's down!
Good shot.
Go and pick it up.
Not bad.
Mine fell first, though.
Now the second one!
Slowly. It can hear your feet.
Keep low, keep low.
Quiet, quiet.
It's off! It landed in the other grass.
You scared it!
I'd go slower, if I were you.
The count! Last one there gets counted with the sheep!
Wait for me!
Sheep first. Children after.
Stand still. If you wiggle, he counts you twice.
You let the mouse go.
When the Tanhu rides by, look at the ground. Everyone does.
text.tr: Tanhu geçerken yere bak. Herkes bakar.

text.en: Count my bird too!
One child.
Two birds, one mouse.
Two birds.
I'll count those too. What is eaten is counted.
text.tr: Onları da sayarım. Yenen de sayılır.

text.en: He saw me.
Shh. He just fell asleep.
The bow stays here; I'll keep it strung. Go on, go and be counted.
text.tr: Yay burada kalır, ben gererim. Sen git, sayılmaya.

text.en: May your road be clear, Mete.
Wave to your brother, Gutu.
My boy, the road is long. I will come every winter.
text.tr: Evladım, yol uzun. Ben her kış gelirim.

text.en: Come, my boy. The road is waiting for us.
Forty-two days of road.
I'll count them.
Count the road home too.
Ride on, my boy. The cart will catch up.
text.tr: Sen sür evladım, araba ardından yetişir.

text.en: Don't go far, my girl.
Sit. Let the kopuz speak first.
Don't walk behind Doru. He kicks.
Up, my girl. Saruk Ebe's churn has gone hungry.
text.tr: Kalk kızım. Saruk Ebe'nin sabası aç kaldı.

text.en: Two skins of mare's milk. You're taking them to Birch Camp. Go slowly over the stream.
text.tr: İki tulum kısrak sütü. Kayın Obası'na sen götüreceksin. Dereyi yavaş geç.

text.en: Ah, my milk is here. Pour it into the churn, then.
text.tr: Hah, sütüm geldi. Dök bakalım sabaya.

text.en: Not a single drop spilled.
Half of it stayed on the road. Never mind. It'll still be kumis.
text.tr: Yarısı yolda kalmış. Olsun, yine kımız olur.

text.en: Kumis is churned a thousand times. You churn twenty. I'll count the rest.
text.tr: Kımız bin kez çalkalanır. Sen yirmisini çalkala, gerisini ben sayarım.

text.en: Twenty. You've a strong arm.
Girls don't make wrestlers.
When the baby comes, there'll be a feast. We'll see then.
text.tr: Bebek gelince toy olur. Orada görürüz.

text.en: Your hands smell of milk. Good.
A blizzard's coming. Your brother and I are going to the horses.
Our fire's gone out! My sister's having the baby, and Grandma needs embers!
text.tr: Ocağımız söndü! Ablam doğuruyor, ebem köz istiyor!

text.en: Take the ember pot. Count the stakes. At the twelfth, you go down to the stream.
text.tr: Köz kabını al. Kazıkları say: on ikincide dereye inersin.

text.en: Keep Boru by your side.
I can't see the stake!
Is that a wolf? It won't come near the fire, will it?
text.tr: Kurt mu o? Ateşin yanına gelmez, değil mi?

text.en: Embers! Bring them here, quick.
The light's back. Now out, both of you. Wait by the door.
text.tr: Işık döndü. Şimdi çıkın, kapıda bekleyin.

text.en: One more.
Is it a boy or a girl?
A life. The rest can wait till morning.
Who brought the fire?
The girl from Lake Camp.
The ewes lambed out in the open last night. Find the lambs and bring them inside. Follow their voices.
text.tr: Koyunlar gece açıkta doğurdu. Kuzuları bul, yurda getir. Sesinden bulursun.

text.en: One.
Two.
Three.
Four. All of them alive.
This one's frozen through. Set it by the fire and drip the first milk into its mouth.
text.tr: Bu donmuş. Ocağın yanına koy, ağzına ilk sütü damlat.

text.en: What's born on a blizzard night lives well. May Kunay's son do the same.
text.tr: Tipi gecesi doğan iyi yaşar. Künay'ın oğlu da öyle olsun.

text.en: There's a watch-night at Birch Camp. In a newborn's first nights the fire never dies, and the laughing never stops.
text.tr: Kayın Obası'nda şilde var. Yeni doğanın ilk gecelerinde ocak sönmez, gülüşme eksik olmaz.

text.en: Let's go. The one who sits outside the light can't stand noise.
text.tr: Gidelim. Işığın dışında oturan gürültüyü sevmez.

text.en: Come here, girl. This kumis is from the milk you brought. Take it with both hands.
text.tr: Gel kız. Bu kımız senin getirdiğin sütten. İki elinle al.

text.en: Sour? The first kumis always is.
text.tr: Ekşi mi? İlk kımız ekşi olur.

text.en: You brought the fire. Let my son know you.
text.tr: Ateşi sen getirdin. Oğlum seni bilsin.

text.en: The little bow stays on the cradle. When he's grown, he'll string it himself.
text.tr: Küçük yay beşikte durur. Büyüyünce kendisi gerer.

text.en: Laugh! A watch-night is never quiet.
Another branch on the fire!
I said girls don't make wrestlers. Come and show me.
text.tr: Kızdan pehlivan olmaz dedim. Gel de göster.

text.en: Nobody lets go of the belt. Whoever's back touches the ground loses.
text.tr: Kuşak bırakılmaz. Sırtı yere değen yenilir.

text.en: Grip!
Again!
Grandma was right.
Who falls gets up. Who gets up, laughs.
Tomorrow you build the fire. The bard means to sing a long one.
text.tr: Yarın ocağı sen kur. Ozan uzun söyleyecek.

text.en: Tonight I'll sing something long. You build the fire. The blizzard cracked the hearthstones.
text.tr: Bu gece uzun bir şey söyleyeceğim. Ateşi sen kur; tipi ocak taşlarını çatlattı.

text.en: There's dry wood at the edge of the forest. Green wood only smokes.
text.tr: Kuru dal orman kıyısında. Yaş odun yalnız duman eder.

text.en: The stream's full of stones. Break a big one and bring three.
text.tr: Derede taş çok. Büyüğünü kır, üçünü getir.

text.en: Three stones. Always three.
Here. Strike the white stone on the black.
text.tr: Al. Ak taşı kara taşa vur.

text.en: It's caught. Feed it.
The light's reached us.
Now it's ready.
Up. Today the three of you are taking the flock to Reed Lake. Luhun knows the way.
text.tr: Kalk. Bugün sürüyü Kamışlı Göl'e üçünüz götüreceksiniz. Luhun yolu bilir.

text.en: Be back before the sun goes down behind the hill.
The lake's that way, past the tamarisks. Follow me.
text.tr: Göl ötede, ılgınların ardında. Ardımdan gelin.

text.en: One's getting away! Head it off!
The ones on the right are scattering!
The lake! The lambs can smell the water.
Who's swimming? Last one in is a frog!
It's deep out there, come back!
There's a white stone at the bottom, by the reeds. Whoever brings it up is a lord.
text.tr: Sazlığın dibinde ak bir taş var. Çıkaran bey olur.

text.en: He got it! The white stone's his!
That cloud looks like a horse.
The Tanhu's horse. A white one.
My father's.
You'll see him at the count.
Let's count them. Drive them between the two stones.
Thirty-eight.
Thirty-nine.
One's missing!
In the reeds! It's stuck in the mud!
A fox! It's waiting for the lamb!
It ran off!
Forty.
The sun's touching the hill. Let's go back!
Forty went out, forty came back.
The moon's coming up! Let's play white bone!
I'll throw it. Whoever finds it runs for the post, and the others try to catch them.
text.tr: Ben atarım. Bulan direğe koşar, ötekiler yakalar.

text.en: White bone, lie in the moonlight!
He's got it! Catch him!
I've got it! I've got it!
It's mine!
You got me! Take it, run!
He made the post!
I made it!
The moon's high. Bed now. Tomorrow someone is going to Hereka.
text.tr: Ay yükseldi. Yatın artık; yarın biri Hereka'ya gidecek.

text.en: The count is the day after tomorrow. Take this dried curd to Hereka, and bring back her tally stick.
text.tr: Öbür gün sayım var. Bu kurutu Hereka Ebe'ye götür, çetelesini al gel.

text.en: And tell her camp about the count. Everyone must hear.
text.tr: Sayımı obasına da söyle. Herkes duysun.

text.en: Hold your dog!
I've got him. Come. Whose boy are you?
Lan Hatun's.
I know. Six autumns ago, at the door, I was the one who counted you.
text.tr: Bilirim. Altı güz önce kapıda seni ben saydım.

text.en: Here. Seven notches, this year's births. Give it to the counter, so he doesn't write us short.
text.tr: Al. Yedi çentik, bu yıl doğanlar. Sayıcıya ver, eksik yazmasın.

text.en: The count's the day after tomorrow!
We heard, we heard.
The horses are fat. We'll come and be counted.
Tell your mother her curd turned out well.
Did you bring it? Seven. The counter will be pleased.
Hereka's notches. Seven.
Kunay's time is near. Kumis gives her strength, and Saruk is waiting.
text.tr: Künay'ın vakti yakın. Kımız ona güç verir; Saruk bekliyor.

text.en: Give Saruk my greetings. And take my love to Kunay.
text.tr: Saruk'a selam söyle. Künay'a da sevgimi götür.

text.en: That yoke's bigger than you, girl. Go slowly.
text.tr: Sırık senden büyük, kızım. Yavaş git.

text.en: The girl from Lake Camp is here! Saruk, your milk is here!
text.tr: Göl Obası'nın kızı geldi! Saruk, sütün geldi!

text.en: Come, catch your breath. That yoke is heavy.
He kicked all morning. Soon, Saruk says.
text.tr: Bu sabah çok tekmeledi. Yakında, diyor Saruk.

text.en: This will be ready in time for the watch-night. It'll bring Kunay's strength back.
text.tr: Bu kımız şildeye yetişir. Künay'ın gücü bununla döner.

text.en: The wind's turned. There'll be a blizzard tonight.
text.tr: Rüzgâr döndü. Bu gece tipi var.

text.en: Tie the door tight. A blizzard knows where the door is.
text.tr: Kapıyı sıkı bağla. Tipi kapının yerini bilir.

text.en: Grandma says in a blizzard only the stakes know the road.
text.tr: Ebem der ki tipide yolu yalnız kazıklar bilir.

text.en: Six. We're halfway.
My sister was crying out. I'm scared.
You never talk, do you? That's all right.
text.tr: Sen hiç konuşmuyorsun, değil mi? Olsun.

text.en: Twelve! The stream's right there!
Grandma says if the light goes out on a birth night, someone waits at the door.
text.tr: Ebem der ki doğum gecesi ışık sönerse kapıda biri bekler.

text.en: But the light's on now. You lit it.
Up. It snowed. The blizzard's gone, and the lambs have come.
text.tr: Kalk, kar yağmış. Tipi gitti, kuzular geldi.

text.en: The horses are all here. And the grey mare's foaled.
text.tr: Atlar tamam. Kır kısrak da taylamış.

text.en: Pick it up. Its mother will follow.
There's one more bleating, down by the stream.
The kopuz strings are cold too. They'll be warm by evening.
text.tr: Kopuzun teli de üşüdü. Akşama ısınır.

text.en: Here. You give this felt swaddle to Kunay.
text.tr: Al, bu keçe kundağı Künay'a sen ver.

text.en: Nobody goes to a watch-night empty-handed.
First to the Sky, then to the Earth, then to the hearth.
text.tr: Önce Gök'e, sonra Yer'e, sonra ocağa.

text.en: From your mother's hands? It's still warm.
Nobody sleeps tonight. Whoever sleeps misses the watch-night.
text.tr: Bu gece kimse uyumaz. Uyuyan şildeyi kaçırır.

text.en: Come on, another song! The baby's listening.
text.tr: Hadi, bir türkü daha! Bebek dinliyor.

text.en: Tonga, long life to your son.
You were the one who brought the fire. There's a place for you at this hearth.
text.tr: Ateşi getiren sendin. Bu ocakta yerin var.

text.en: Make a ring! The girl from Lake Camp against Boru!
text.tr: Halka açılsın! Göl Obası'nın kızı Börü'ye karşı!

text.en: Keep your weight in your feet. When he pushes, give way.
The winner spreads her arms like an eagle. Go on.
text.tr: Kazanan kartal gibi açar kollarını. Hadi.

text.en: Let's wrestle again tomorrow.
Tonight is the bard's night. Everyone will be at the fire.
text.tr: Bu gece ozanın gecesi. Herkes ateşin başında olacak.

text.en: Do you know why three? I'll tell it tonight.
text.tr: Neden üç, biliyor musun? Bu gece anlatacağım.

text.en: With this much wood it'll burn till morning.
text.tr: Bu kadar odunla sabaha dek yanar.

text.en: Come, sit by me.
Did you bring your bow? There are ducks at the lake.
text.tr: Yayını aldın mı? Gölde ördek olur.

text.en: My father says the Yellow River used to run through here. The lake is what it left behind.
text.tr: Babam der ki Sarı Irmak eskiden buradan akarmış. Göl ondan kalmış.

text.en: The river left and forgot the lake.
It didn't forget. It's waiting.
Cranes! They're going south.
One day we'll go too.
Look, the smoke from the Dailin. Everyone's coming to the count.
text.tr: Bak, Dailin'in dumanları. Sayıma herkes geliyor.

text.en: The water's freezing!
A fish touched my foot!
I'll give this to my mother.
Will the counter count us too?
He counts everyone. If he doesn't count you, you're not there.
Let's have them in the pen before the moon's up. It's the wolves' hour.
text.tr: Ay doğmadan ağılda olalım. Kurt saatidir.

text.en: A white stone… You keep it. A white stone knows the way.
text.tr: Ak taş… Sende kalsın. Ak taş yolu bilir.

text.en: Don't wander off. Moonlight shows the bone, and it shows the wolf too.
text.tr: Uzaklaşmayın. Ay ışığı kemiği gösterir, kurdu da.

text.en: Wait… I can't breathe…
You're slower than the old sheep!
Another round! I'm throwing this time.
text.tr: Bir el daha! Bu kez ben atarım.

text.en: My father's bowing to the moon now.
Hereka keeps count of the newborns. Without her stick, the counter will write us short.
text.tr: Hereka yeni doğanları sayar. Çetelesi olmazsa sayıcı bizi eksik yazar.

text.en: Come in. Don't touch the herbs. Each one is for a birth.
text.tr: Gir. Otlara dokunma; her biri bir doğum için.

text.en: The dawn you were born, the full moon was setting and the sun was rising. Your father bowed to them both.
text.tr: Doğduğun şafak dolunay batıyordu, güneş doğuyordu. Baban ikisine de eğildi.

text.en: Tell the counter our foal should be counted too.
text.tr: Sayıcıya söyle, bizim tay da sayılsın.

text.en: What did Hereka say?
She counted me.
That's right. It was her voice at the door.
I got there first! Me!
My mother sent it. To say thank you.
